summary: Iteration 25 – tested new Hentai RoSub + Seriale TV verticals (backend + frontend). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (CRUD for hentai-series, hentai-seasons, tv-series, tv-seasons, slug uniqueness, cascade delete of series→seasons, default /api/videos + ?section=popular filter out is_hentai/is_tv, PATCH video derives *_series_id from *_season_id, PATCH with invalid season→400). Frontend: sidebar nav-hentai + nav-seriale-tv present; /hentai and /seriale-tv pages render with search inputs (hentai-search-input + tv-search-input); search filter correctly hides series and shows empty state; existing verticals' search inputs (anime, filme, shorts xxx, shorts drama) all present; Home sections hentai/filme/tv are conditional (render only when data exists – by design); section-popular + text 'Cele mai Vizionate' confirmed removed; home vertical tabs home-vertical-hentai + home-vertical-tv exist and clickable; admin tabs tab-hentai-series + tab-tv-series render with CRUD forms; upload page has upload-is-hentai + upload-is-tv toggles (inside upload-is-hentai-block / upload-is-tv-block that only render after a file is staged – matching Anime behavior).

issues: A modal titled 'AAAAAAAA' with body 'Si cam atata' is open on first load and intercepts clicks until dismissed (pre-existing announcement/test modal from prior iterations – not part of this iteration but blocks fresh-user flows).

action_items: Consider removing or gating the global 'AAAAAAAA / Si cam atata' modal that auto-opens on every page load (blocks interactions in automated tests and is likely leftover debug content).
Nice-to-have: on /hentai and /seriale-tv landing pages, make the search input disabled or hidden when series.length === 0 (currently search exists but there's nothing to filter).
critical_code_review_comments: VerticalSeriesPage.jsx generic component is cleanly reused for both /hentai and /seriale-tv – good DRY.
Backend mutual exclusivity order (short > anime > hentai > tv > film_rosub) is enforced consistently in upload finish and reflected in Upload.jsx UI conditionals – correct.

Cascade delete of hentai-series detaches videos (resets is_anime=false which is correct, but should it also clear is_hentai? Current code sets is_anime=false but leaves is_hentai=True on orphaned videos). Minor consistency issue – videos will keep is_hentai=True but have null hentai_series_id and will no longer appear anywhere.
server.py is 6562 lines – approaching maintainability limits; recommend modular split (routers per vertical) in a future iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable surface (routes, testids, search, admin tabs, home tabs)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates TEST_H_* / TEST_TV_* series/seasons and auto-cleans via module-scoped fixture teardown. No orphan data left in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hentai + TV verticals mirror Anime architecture 1:1. Backend uses db.hentai_series / db.hentai_seasons / db.tv_series / db.tv_seasons collections. Frontend VerticalSeriesPage drives /hentai and /seriale-tv landing. Upload hentai/tv blocks only render after a file is staged (addFiles). Hentai/TV detail routes use HentaiSeriesDetail/HentaiSeasonDetail/TvSeriesDetail/TvSeasonDetail with 'not-found' fallback testids (hentai-series-not-found, tv-series-not-found). All data-testids follow prefix pattern: hentai-* for /hentai, tv-* for /seriale-tv. There is a global modal ('AAAAAAAA') blocking first interaction – dismiss with Escape or close button before any UI click in Playwright.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A – no bugs found. All iteration-25 requirements verified end-to-end.
